title: Some Historical Problems in the Book of Daniel (in Notes on Some Problems in the Book of Daniel, pp. 9–18)

verification_log.method: Downloaded the chapter PDF from biblicalstudies.org.uk (reproduced with the author's permission): https://biblicalstudies.org.uk/pdf/tp/notes-daniel/daniel_wiseman.pdf

pp. 9–18: rejects the Gubaru theory (no evidence Gubaru bore a royal title; contracts of 535–524 call him governor) and proposes Darius the Mede = Cyrus, reading 6:28 appositionally; on Dan 1:1, Daniel's accession-year reckoning vs Jeremiah's non-accession reckoning removes the discrepancy, and the extant data "does not allow any dogmatic assertion against the historical accuracy of this verse"
